question: Which uses of AI are completely banned in the EU, for example social scoring?
note: Art. 5(1) lists the prohibited AI practices; point (c) is social scoring.

question: Darf ein Arbeitgeber KI einsetzen, um die Emotionen seiner Mitarbeitenden zu erkennen?
note: Art. 5(1)(f) prohibits emotion recognition in the workplace (except medical/safety reasons).

question: How do I find out whether my AI system counts as high-risk?
note: Art. 6 holds the classification rules (product safety route in (1), Annex III route in (2), exceptions in (3)). Article level on purpose: several paragraphs are relevant.

question: Gilt ein KI-System, das Bewerbungen automatisch vorsortiert, als Hochrisiko-System?
note: Annex III point 4(a) lists AI for recruitment and filtering applications; Art. 6(2) makes Annex III systems high-risk. Either counts.

question: What does the risk management system for a high-risk AI system have to cover?
note: Art. 9 (risk management system); the content is spread over paragraphs 1-9, so article level.

question: Welche Qualitätsanforderungen gelten für die Trainings-, Validierungs- und Testdaten eines Hochrisiko-KI-Systems?
note: Art. 10 (data and data governance), mainly (2)-(4). Note: old Art. 10(5) on special categories was moved to Art. 4a in the consolidated text.

question: What should the people overseeing a high-risk AI system be able to do?
note: Art. 14(4) lists what the persons assigned to human oversight must be enabled to do (understand, interpret, override, stop).

question: Muss ich Nutzern sagen, dass sie mit einem Chatbot und nicht mit einem Menschen sprechen?
note: Art. 50(1): systems that interact directly with people must inform them that they are interacting with an AI system.

question: Do deepfake videos have to be labelled as artificially generated?
note: Art. 50(4): deployers of deep fakes must disclose that the content was artificially generated or manipulated.

question: Muss ich als Arbeitgeber meine Beschäftigten informieren, bevor ich ein Hochrisiko-KI-System am Arbeitsplatz einsetze?
note: Art. 26(7): employers must inform workers' representatives and affected workers before use at the workplace.

question: How high can the fines be for using a prohibited AI practice?
note: Art. 99(3): up to EUR 35 million or 7 % of worldwide annual turnover.

question: Welche Dokumentation müssen Anbieter von KI-Modellen mit allgemeinem Verwendungszweck erstellen?
note: Art. 53(1)(a)-(d): technical documentation, information for downstream providers, copyright policy, training-content summary.

question: Do companies that use AI have to make sure their staff understand AI?
note: Art. 4(1) AI literacy (as amended in the consolidated text: providers and deployers take measures to support AI literacy of their staff).

question: Wie definiert die KI-Verordnung den Begriff KI-System?
note: Art. 3 point (1) defines 'AI system'; in our chunks each definition of Art. 3 is its own paragraph, so (1) = this definition.

question: How quickly must a provider report a serious incident caused by its high-risk AI system?
note: Art. 73(2): immediately after establishing a causal link, and not later than 15 days after becoming aware (shorter deadlines in (3) and (4)).

question: Auf welcher Rechtsgrundlage darf ein Unternehmen personenbezogene Daten verarbeiten?
note: GDPR Art. 6(1) lists the six legal bases (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, legitimate interests).

question: Can I make a company delete the personal data it holds about me?
note: GDPR Art. 17(1), right to erasure, with the grounds (a)-(f).

question: Wie schnell muss eine Datenpanne der Aufsichtsbehörde gemeldet werden?
note: GDPR Art. 33(1): without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours.

question: What makes consent valid, and can it be withdrawn later?
note: GDPR Art. 7 conditions for consent; withdrawal is Art. 7(3). Article level because the question spans several paragraphs.

question: Wann muss ein Unternehmen einen Datenschutzbeauftragten benennen?
note: GDPR Art. 37(1)(a)-(c): public authority, large-scale monitoring, large-scale special categories.

question: Which kinds of personal data count as especially sensitive under the GDPR?
note: GDPR Art. 9(1) lists the special categories (health, biometric, religion, ...).

question: Welche Informationen muss ein Unternehmen mir geben, wenn es Daten direkt bei mir erhebt?
note: GDPR Art. 13 (information where data are collected from the data subject), paragraphs 1 and 2.

question: When do we have to carry out a data protection impact assessment?
note: GDPR Art. 35: (1) the high-risk trigger, (3) the cases where it is always required.

question: Kann ich verlangen, meine Daten in einem maschinenlesbaren Format zu bekommen, um zu einem anderen Anbieter zu wechseln?
note: GDPR Art. 20(1), right to data portability.

question: What is the highest fine a company can get for breaking the GDPR?
note: GDPR Art. 83(5): up to EUR 20 million or 4 % of worldwide turnover (Art. 83(4) is the lower tier).

question: Ab welchem Alter darf ein Kind selbst in die Datenverarbeitung durch eine App einwilligen?
note: GDPR Art. 8(1): 16 years, Member States may lower it to 13.

question: Does the GDPR still apply once data has been anonymised?
note: GDPR Recital 26: the principles do not apply to anonymous information. (Art. 4(1) defines personal data but does not say this.)

question: Dürfen personenbezogene Daten in ein Land außerhalb der EU übermittelt werden, für das die Kommission einen Angemessenheitsbeschluss erlassen hat?
note: GDPR Art. 45(1): transfers on the basis of an adequacy decision need no specific authorisation.

question: What has to be written into a contract between a controller and a processor?
note: GDPR Art. 28(3) lists the mandatory contract content.

question: As a developer, do I have to build privacy protections into my app from the start?
note: GDPR Art. 25(1), data protection by design ((2) is by default).

question: A bank's AI system rejected my loan application automatically. What rights do I have?
note: GDPR Art. 22 (solely automated decisions) and AI Act Art. 86(1) (right to explanation for Annex III decisions; credit scoring is Annex III point 5(b)). Either counts.

question: Darf ein Anbieter von Hochrisiko-KI sensible Daten wie die ethnische Herkunft verarbeiten, um Verzerrungen zu erkennen?
note: AI Act Art. 4a(1) (consolidated text): special categories for bias detection under strict conditions. In the original 2024 text this was Art. 10(5).

question: Does the AI Act replace the GDPR when an AI system processes personal data?
note: AI Act Art. 2(7): Union data protection law applies; the AI Act does not affect the GDPR (without prejudice to Art. 4a and 59).

question: Muss der Betreiber eines Hochrisiko-KI-Systems eine Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzung durchführen, und welche Informationen kann er dafür nutzen?
note: AI Act Art. 26(9): deployers use the provider's Art. 13 information for their DPIA under GDPR Art. 35. Either counts.

question: Kann ich für die Grundrechte-Folgenabschätzung Teile einer bestehenden Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzung wiederverwenden?
note: AI Act Art. 27(4): the FRIA may cross-reference or include parts of the GDPR DPIA.

question: What is the corporate income tax rate in Germany?
note: Tax law, not in either regulation.

question: Which obligations does the Digital Markets Act impose on gatekeepers?
note: A different EU regulation (DMA), not in the corpus. Near-domain trap.

question: Wie hoch ist der gesetzliche Mindestlohn in Deutschland?
note: Labour law, not in either regulation.

question: Wie lange ist die Kündigungsfrist für einen Mietvertrag?
note: Tenancy law, not in either regulation.

question: Welche Python-Bibliothek eignet sich am besten zum Trainieren neuronaler Netze?
note: A programming question; AI-sounding but not a legal question.
